summary_md: **Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2116748078732673137))** cites a scan finding 26.1% of 31,132 agent skills vulnerable and 5.2% likely malicious, and recommends NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 **SkillSpector**, which checks skills against 71 patterns from prompt injection to MCP tool poisoning ([NVIDIA/SkillSpector](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector)).
